    An event whose operation can be vetoed in the EventPhase.PRE phase.

    Something a player asks a machine to do from a menu (D40): take an upgrade out, switch a module off, … A machine type declares its actions by id (MachineType.Builder.action(String, MachineAction)); a menu button names one (machineengine_action, action: <id>) and runs it with the click.

    MachineError.SerializationError

    A handler refused a transfer.

    One change to a ModifierType's value.
    Modifier.Operation
    Applied in this order, like Minecraft attribute modifiers (D16).
    Modifiers
    Applies modifiers with the D16 stacking rule: base → +ΣADD → ×(1+ΣADD_MULTIPLIED_BASE) → ×Π(1+MULTIPLY_TOTAL) → clamp.
    ModifierType
    A numeric value machines let upgrades modify (ARCHITECTURE.md §14), e.g.
    MultiblockDefinitions
    Multiblocks in data-driven definitions (D33): the multiblocks: section of a definitions file, and the behavior type machineengine:multiblock_member.
    MultiblockMember
    A block of a multiblock (D33): a frame block, valve or port, as a machine behavior.
    MultiblockMember.AnchorTask
    Work an anchor does while its structure is formed (e.g.
    MultiblockMember.Builder
    Makes the behavior factories of members.
    MultiblockMember.PortRate
    What an output port pushes per tick, from the structure and the port block's options (D34).
    Multiblocks
    Finding multiblocks in the world, and the formed ones (D33).
    MultiblockShape
    What blocks a multiblock is made of, and where (D33).
    MultiblockShape.Box
    A hollow box: frame blocks make its six walls (an open top: five), casings every edge and corner, and its interior holds what interior allows.
    MultiblockShape.Pattern
    A fixed shape, like a crafting recipe in 3D: layers from the bottom up, each a list of rows from north to south, each row a string of characters from west to east.
    MultiblockShape.Pattern.Cell
    One block of the shape: its offset (x east, y up, z south) and character, unturned.
    MultiblockStructure
    A formed multiblock (D33).
    MultiblockType
    A kind of multiblock (D33): its shape, and the capacities its anchor's storages get while it is formed.
    MultiblockType.Sizes
    The anchor's storage capacities while formed, from the structure and the anchor block's options (D34).

    How a network moves resources (SPI).

    What a NetworkBehavior sees during one network tick.
    NetworkEndpoint
    A machine port, or a container block, touching a network.
    NetworkType
    A kind of network (ARCHITECTURE.md §15): which transports join each other and how the network moves resources between the machines attached to it.
    NetworkView
    Snapshot of a network for inspection (§27).
    Nms
    The NmsAccess of the running server (D28).
    NmsAccess
    Everything MachineEngine and its addons need that differs between supported Minecraft versions (D25): newer API, or API whose binary shape changed.

    Reaching other machines by position (MachineContext.machines()), e.g.
    PaperItemBehavior
    A CraftEngine item behavior written with Bukkit types (D32): right-clicks with the item in the main hand arrive as one PaperItemBehavior.use(Use), whether on a block or in the air, and PaperItemBehavior.useOnEntity(Player, ItemStack, Entity) on an entity.
    PaperItemBehavior.Use
    A right-click with the item.

    Resources held by items on Paper (D32): what an item holds comes from its ResourceItem CraftEngine behaviors, the amounts live in its CraftEngine item data under minecraft:custom_data → machineengine.resources.<type>.
    PaperItems
    Converts between Paper ItemStacks and Items.ITEM resources (§23.4).
